name: @latticekit/resonance
description: RESONANCE — a gallery exhibit. A dark cavern where every locked gate hums a chord and you answer it on six tuned strings.
$comment: Seven of nine, and this is the first exhibit in the gallery that names @latticekit/audio — sound is not decoration here, it is the only channel the puzzle travels down. sim is absent because there is no economy; persist is absent because docs/GALLERY.md forbids a row any state that outlives the tab, and the mixer snapshot this exhibit could hand it is a device preference rather than save state. input and loop arrive through examples/_shared's bootstrap and are named because the strings are bound to keys through them.
